loginSubtitle: Sign in to the Library Management System
name: Name
welcomeSubtitle: Stay connected with your library — sign in with your account to continue.
joinSubtitle: Create your new member account and start exploring our digital library collection.
fillYourInfo: Fill in your information to register a new member account.
registrationMessage: Your account is active — you can already log in with your email and password. A librarian will issue your library QR card shortly; you can check its status anytime from Settings → Security.
accessDeniedMessage: You do not have permission to access this page. Please contact your administrator if you believe this is an error.
qrHint: Point your library QR card at the camera above.
qrUnsupported: Camera scanning isn't supported on this device. Please use email and password instead.
qrPermissionDenied: Camera access was blocked. Allow the camera in your browser's site settings, then try again.
qrNoCamera: No camera was found on this device.
qrInsecure: Camera needs a secure connection (HTTPS). Please open the site over HTTPS.
qrCameraFailed: Could not start the camera. Close other apps using it, then try again.
scanSubtitle: Dedicated kiosk mode — point your library QR card at the camera.
pointCard: Point your library QR card at the camera above.
cameraNotSupported: Camera scanning isn't supported in this browser.
usePhoneInstructions: Open your phone's camera or any QR app and point it at this code
enterThisPin: Enter this PIN on your phone
forgotPasswordSubtitle: No worries — we'll email you a link to reset it.
forgotPasswordInstructions: Enter the email you registered with and we'll send you a reset link.
resetLinkSentMessage: If an account exists for {email}, a password reset link has been sent. The link expires in 60 minutes.
resetPasswordSubtitle: Choose a strong password you haven't used before.
invalidResetLinkMessage: This link is incomplete or broken. Please request a new password reset link.
passwordResetDoneMessage: Your password has been reset and you were signed out on all devices. Please sign in with your new password.

validation.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters

activateLink: Got a student ID from school? Activate your account
registrationClosed: Online registration is closed. Please visit the front desk.

activate.title: Activate your account
activate.subtitle: For students the school has already added. Use your student ID and date of birth to set a password and PIN.

forceChange.title: Please change your password
forceChange.subtitle: You are using a password someone else created. Set your own password before you continue.

idleLock.title: Screen locked
idleLock.subtitle: No activity for a while. Enter your password to continue.

logoutAll.title: Log out of all devices
logoutAll.subtitle: Use this if you lost your phone or logged in on someone else's computer. Every device, including this one, must log in again.

pending.empty: No one is waiting for approval
pending.hint: Check the ID card, choose the membership type, then approve.

import.title: Import students/teachers from Excel
import.subtitle: Columns: student_id, name, class_name, date_of_birth, membership_type, phone, email (phone and email optional). Accounts are created as "not activated" and students activate them themselves.
import.fixFirst: Fix the rows with errors in the file and check again.
import.ready: All rows are valid. Click Import to create the accounts.

reset.title: Reset password / PIN
reset.subtitle: Create a temporary password for a member with no email or a forgotten PIN. They must change it at first login.
reset.confirm: Reset this member's password and PIN? All their devices will be logged out.
reset.resultHint: Shown only this once. Tell the member in person.

settings.title: Login & registration
settings.subtitle: Control how people create accounts and log in.
settings.activation_enabled: Students can activate their own account
settings.missing: Settings not found yet. Run the migration first.
